Name: Verify successful login with valid business email and valid password
Precondition: User has an active, registered Creatio CRM account. Chrome browser is open.
Objective: Verify that an existing user can log in to Creatio CRM successfully using valid business email and password.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Launch browser and navigate to Creatio CRM login URL
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Creatio CRM login page is loaded successfully displaying Business Email and Password fields.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter valid business email in the Business Email input field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email is accepted without red highlight or validation error messages.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter valid password in the Password input field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Password input is masked with bullets/asterisks and accepted without error messages.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click the Log in button
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User is authenticated successfully and redirected to Creatio CRM application dashboard.

Name: Verify successful validation acceptance of boundary maximum valid email length (400 characters)
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is loaded and displayed in the browser.
Objective: Verify that a business email address containing exactly 400 valid characters is accepted without triggering format or length errors.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login URL
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Creatio CRM login page is displayed with empty Business Email and Password fields.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an RFC-compliant valid email string of exactly 400 characters into the Business Email field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Full 400-character email is entered into the Business Email field without clipping.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Tab out or click into the Password field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email field is not highlighted in red and no 'Invalid email format' error message is displayed.

Name: Verify successful validation acceptance of boundary maximum valid password length (100 characters)
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is loaded and displayed in the browser.
Objective: Verify that a password containing exactly 100 characters is accepted without triggering boundary length validation errors.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login page is displayed successfully.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter a valid business email address into the Business Email field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Email is accepted without validation errors.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter a secure password of exactly 100 characters into the Password field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Password is accepted, masked with bullets, and field remains in normal state without red highlight.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Tab out of the Password field or click outside
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Password field is not highlighted in red and no error message 'Invalid value. Value must contain up to 100 characters' appears.

Name: Verify Business Email validation and red highlight for invalid email formats missing @ or domain
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is open in the browser.
Objective: Verify that entering malformed email strings missing @ or domain triggers red highlight and 'Invalid email format' message (AC1).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Creatio CRM login page is loaded.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an email string without @ symbol into the Business Email field and click outside the field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email field is highlighted in red and displays error message 'Invalid email format'.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Clear the field and enter an email missing domain name (e.g. user@) and press Tab
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email field is highlighted in red and displays error message 'Invalid email format'.

Name: Verify Business Email validation and red highlight for invalid domain name format
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is open in the browser.
Objective: Verify that entering an email with an invalid domain structure triggers red highlight and error message (AC1).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login page is displayed.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an email with an incomplete domain name missing TLD extension into the Business Email field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email field is highlighted in red and shows error message 'Invalid email format'.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Clear and enter an email with invalid domain syntax containing dot right after @ or invalid host
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email field remains highlighted in red and shows error message 'Invalid email format'.

Name: Verify Business Email field boundary validation and red highlight when input exceeds 400 characters
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is loaded in the browser.
Objective: Verify that entering an email address of 401 characters triggers red highlight and 'Invalid email format' error message (AC2).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Creatio CRM login page is displayed with empty input fields.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an email string with exactly 401 characters (boundary + 1) into the Business Email field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Email string of 401 characters is entered into the Business Email input field.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click outside the field or press Tab to trigger validation
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email field is highlighted in red and displays error message 'Invalid email format'.

Name: Verify Password field boundary validation and red highlight when input exceeds 100 characters
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is open in the browser.
Objective: Verify that entering a password exceeding 100 characters (101 characters) triggers red highlight and exact error message 'Invalid value. Value must contain up to 100 characters' (AC3).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login page is displayed.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter a valid business email in the Business Email field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Business Email is accepted without validation errors.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter a password of exactly 101 characters (boundary + 1) into the Password field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: 101 characters are entered in masked format.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click outside the Password field or click the Log in button
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Password field is highlighted in red and displays error message 'Invalid value. Value must contain up to 100 characters'.

Name: Verify authentication failure error message at bottom of page for invalid credentials
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is displayed.
Objective: Verify that submitting invalid user credentials displays 'Invalid email or password' error message at the bottom of the page (AC4).
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login page is displayed.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an un-registered or incorrect business email format
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Email is entered without field-level format error.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an incorrect password
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Password is masked and entered into field.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click the Log in button
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Authentication fails and error message 'Invalid email or password' is displayed at the bottom of the page.

Name: Verify form submission behavior and mandatory field error indications when submitting blank credentials
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is open in the browser.
Objective: Verify that clicking the Log in button with empty email and password fields prevents form submission and indicates required fields.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login page is displayed with empty Business Email and Password fields.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Leave Business Email and Password fields blank and click the Log in button
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Form submission is blocked and mandatory field validation indicators appear.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Verify that user remains on the login page without unexpected redirects
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: User remains on the login page at URL https://accounts.creatio.com/login/alm and no unhandled error occurs.

Name: Verify simultaneous field validation handling when both email and password exceed length limits
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is open in the browser.
Objective: Verify that when both fields simultaneously violate boundary rules (>400 email, >100 password), both fields show red highlight and respective error messages.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login page is displayed.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter an email exceeding 400 characters in Business Email and a password exceeding 100 characters in Password
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Test Data: Email: 405-character email string, Password: 105-character password string
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Characters are entered into both fields.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Click the Log in button
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Both fields are highlighted in red simultaneously; Business Email displays 'Invalid email format' and Password displays 'Invalid value. Value must contain up to 100 characters'.

Name: Verify handling of leading and trailing whitespace in Business Email and Password fields
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is open in the browser.
Objective: Verify whether leading and trailing whitespace in Business Email is trimmed or flagged as invalid format, and password whitespace is securely handled.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Login page is displayed.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter business email with leading and trailing spaces into Business Email field
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: If auto-trimmed, field accepts valid email; if un-trimmed whitespace is disallowed, field highlights in red with 'Invalid email format'.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Enter valid password containing spaces as part of passphrase and click Log in
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Password characters including spaces are preserved and submitted to authentication service without corruption.

Name: Verify error state clearance and dynamic recovery upon correcting invalid inputs
Precondition: Creatio CRM login page is displayed with active validation errors.
Objective: Verify that red highlighting and error messages clear dynamically when the user replaces invalid input with valid data.
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Navigate to Creatio CRM login page and enter invalid email 'invalid.user' and 105-char password to trigger error states
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Both fields are highlighted in red with corresponding error messages.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Clear Business Email field and enter a valid business email format
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Red highlight and 'Invalid email format' error message disappear dynamically from the Business Email field.

Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Step: Clear Password field and enter a valid 12-character password
Test Script (Step-by-Step) - Expected Re: Red highlight and 'Invalid value. Value must contain up to 100 characters' error message disappear dynamically from the Password field.
